title: Kardeş

characters.SIS: a little girl of about eight with two long brown braids, wearing a red sweater
characters.BRO: her little brother, a boy of about six with messy black hair, wearing a green sweater
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with long brown hair in a single braid, wearing a red coat
characters.MAN: a man of about twenty-eight with short black hair and a small beard, wearing a green jacket

scenes.text:
Çocukken aynı odayı,
aynı yorganı paylaştınız.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy children's bedroom on a winter night, {SIS} on the left and {BRO} on the right share one big patchwork quilt and giggle with a flashlight, snow outside the window.
At a kitchen table, {SIS} and {BRO} both reach with forks for the last slice of cake on a plate, laughing playfully, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Büyüyünce ayrı şehirlere,
ayrı hayatlara dağıldınız.
scenes.prompt: On a snowy train platform, {WOMAN} on the left waves goodbye from the train door while {MAN} on the right waves back from the platform, soft winter light.

scenes.text: Ama yan yana oturunca yine o küçük çocuklar olursunuz.
scenes.prompt: In the same old children's bedroom, {WOMAN} on the left and {MAN} on the right sit side by side under the old patchwork quilt laughing, snow falling outside the window.

scenes.text: Kardeş, çocukluğunu seninle birlikte hatırlayan kişidir.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} and {MAN} walk side by side through a snowy park at dusk, seen from behind, his arm around her shoulder, warm street lamps.

caption:
Aynı odadan çıkıp ayrı hayatlara dağıldınız ama bağ hiç kopmadı. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
